_source: README Expected outcomes — E2E-38, AUTOMATED HALF ONLY. Every outcome is a silentDropCount value on a FindingDispositionRecord, read from DynamoDB after a manual unrelated-file push — and the drop itself is explicitly stochastic (the README notes review #2 may legitimately keep the finding). Asserted here: review #1 lands, which is the precondition for the DB half. The DynamoDB commands are in the fixture's own procedure, corrected in fixtures#1142. Labelled `mechanical` (mergewatch.ai#660): any completed review posts the summary comment (postSummaryOnClean defaults to true; `stayingSilent`, review-agent.ts:1051) and renders a score badge (`formatReviewComment`, comment-formatter.ts:760), so a full-range score and a present comment hold for every model output.
